summary: This page outlines the formalization of generative learning tasks in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), distinguishing between predictive analysis and distribution learning for graph generation. It details supervised generative GNN tasks, including the generation of adjacency matrices, node features, and edge features, along with corresponding mapping functions and loss functions. The page also illustrates various applications such as graph super-resolution, multigraph prediction, and brain graph evolution prediction.
